messages:
sam: heads up - canarying zephyrus-v3 embeddings (hf/zephyrus-v3) on staging. int4 build shows big recall regression on multilingual holdout. clustering also smells off. anyone free to triage?
lin: saw the alert. quick numbers: beacon-v2 fp32 recall@10=0.845; zephyrus fp32=0.832; zephyrus int4 (symmetric calib)=0.662. thats a big drop.
raja: ouch. what about silhouette / inter-cluster distances?
sam: ran a quick cluster audit on 10k holdout: fp32 silhouette=0.21, int4 silhouette=-0.03. centroid radius (mean l2) fp32=1.12, int4=0.18. pairwise cosine median: fp32=0.12, int4=0.93.
lin: sounds like anisotropy / scale collapse after quant. likely suspects: activation clipping too aggressive, layernorm folding removed a postnorm scaling, or pooling mismatch.
raja: did we change pooling? I thought zephyrus uses mean pooling + l2 postnorm. if export dropped the postnorm op for int4 that's a quick root cause.
qa-bot: canary: zephyrus-int4 -> staging deployed sha=5f2b1c (2025-09-18T09:04:01Z). Running baseline smoke-eval.
sam: small repro: `python eval/embeddings_eval.py --model zephyrus --quant int4 --holdout multilingual-10k --k 10 --out /tmp/z_v3.json` produced: recall@1=0.41, recall@5=0.58, recall@10=0.662, mean_norm=0.183, pairwise_cosine_75p=0.96.
lin: can you run an experiment turning off quant for the final normalization op (postnorm kept in fp32) and see effect? quick patch to runtime allows per-op fallback.
raja: also try per-channel vs per-tensor and use percentile clipping (99.99) instead of min-max. int4 is very sensitive to outliers.
sam: request: run these variants + compute nn-distance CDF and silhouette. ill attach UMAP + silhouette plot.
lin: FYI i noticed our int4 exporter applies symmetric quant with zero-point=0. when activations are strictly positive after relu-ish ops that can bias scales. try asymmetric (affine) quant for activations.
qa-bot: scheduled jobs: quant_sweep: [per-tensor,per-channel] x [symmetric,asymmetric] x [minmax,99.99pct] on multilingual-10k. ETA ~2h.
raja: interim mitigation: pause canary and keep zephyrus fp32 in staging. set knn dedupe threshold lower so duplicates don't surface to users. we should not promote int4 until silhouette >0.15 and recall@10 within 0.02 of fp32.
sam: rollback trigger set. opening PR to change exporter to preserve postnorm op and to enable per-op fp fallback for norm/pooling ops. will add test that asserts mean_norm > 0.8 after quant.
lin: add anisotropy metric to nightly eval: fraction of pairs with cosine>0.9 and median nearest-neighbor distance.
raja: final checklist: 1) reproduce with postnorm disabled intentionally, 2) run quant variants (per-channel + asymmetric + 99.99pct), 3) run pooling parity test against beacon baseline (mean pooling + l2 postnorm), 4) add automated assertions, 5) once int4 meets thresholds, re-canary.
sam: assigning: [sam] PR + repro plots, [lin] quant sweep configs, [raja] exporter LN/postnorm audit. will post numbers here. :thumbsup:
